b2-01.title: Brunch at the bistro
b2-01.story: On Sunday, Anna and Max met Lisa for [[brunch]] at a tiny [[bistro]] near the river. Max ordered a stack of [[pancakes|pancake]] with fresh berries, while Lisa chose [[French toast]] sprinkled with [[cinnamon]]. Anna couldn't decide, so the waiter suggested a latte with homemade [[caramel]]. "Our house coffee is a special [[blend]] from Colombia and Ethiopia," he explained proudly. When the plates arrived, Max realized that his stack looked rather dry. He had completely forgotten to ask for a [[topping]]. Lisa laughed and pushed her little jug of maple syrup across the table. "Sharing is the best part of Sunday," she said.

b2-02.title: Street food festival
b2-02.story: On Saturday, Anna and Max skipped the usual [[drive-through]] and went to the street festival at the old [[food market]] downtown. Dozens of stalls were already busy, and the smell of grilled meat filled the air. Max went straight to a bright orange [[food truck]] and ordered a spicy [[burrito]]. Anna watched the cook warm each [[tortilla]] on a hot pan before folding it carefully. Then they shared a huge plate of [[nachos]] covered in fresh [[guacamole]]. Ira joined them later with a chicken [[kebab]] and a tub of garlic yogurt [[dip]]. "We've eaten nothing but [[junk food]] all day," Anna groaned, holding her stomach. Max just grinned and pointed at the ice cream stand.

b2-03.title: Cooking dinner at home
b2-03.story: When Anna's parents went out for the evening, Anna promised to cook dinner for Taras and their grandparents. Grandpa asked for mushroom [[risotto]], so she stirred the rice slowly and grated plenty of [[parmesan]] on top. Grandma, who doesn't eat meat, wanted something lighter, so Anna fried [[tofu]] and vegetables in a hot [[wok]]. Taras, of course, refused everything except [[mac and cheese]]. Meanwhile, Anna boiled a bag of spinach [[ravioli]] from the freezer and sliced some [[salami]] and [[pepperoni]] for a quick snack plate. There was even leftover [[roast beef]] from Sunday, which Grandpa happily claimed as well. As a final touch, she shaved a little black [[truffle]], a gift from her aunt, over his mushroom rice. When her parents came home, the kitchen was a mess, but every single plate was empty.

b2-04.title: A healthy lunch
b2-04.story: Lisa had recently found out that she couldn't eat [[gluten]], so Anna offered to help her plan a healthy lunch for school. They started with a big bowl of [[kale]], tossed with seeds and a [[lite]] lemon [[dressing]]. Instead of bread, Lisa packed a large rice [[cracker]] and a small tub of [[hummus]]. For something sweet, Anna suggested adding some [[citrus]], since it's full of vitamin C. Lisa grabbed a [[mandarin]] from the fruit bowl, and Anna added a [[tangerine]] next to it. "Wait, what's the difference between them?" Lisa asked. Anna shrugged and admitted that she honestly had no idea.

b2-05.title: The dessert menu
b2-05.story: For Grandma's birthday, the whole family went to a café famous for its desserts. The menu was so long that Taras read it out loud like a story. Dad chose a warm [[pecan]] [[tart]], and Mama ordered a slice of [[red velvet]] with cream cheese frosting. Anna couldn't resist the chocolate [[mousse]], while Grandpa stayed loyal to his favorite rice [[pudding]]. Taras wanted a [[sundae]] covered in sprinkles, with a toasted [[marshmallow]] on top. Grandma studied the menu carefully and asked whether the fruit jelly contained [[gelatin]], because she prefers desserts without it. In the end, she ordered a [[brownie]] with a candle in it. Everyone sang "Happy Birthday" so loudly that the other customers joined in.

b2-06.title: A weekend food tour
b2-06.story: Last summer, Max and his sister Sofia spent a weekend exploring their city's international neighborhood on a self-guided food tour. They began at a busy bakery, where they split a warm sesame [[bagel]] with plenty of [[cream cheese]]. Next door, a small tea room served a crumbly [[scone]] with strawberry jam, which Sofia declared the best she had ever tasted. By lunchtime, they had found a Korean restaurant and ordered steaming bowls of [[ramen]]. The owner brought them a free side of [[kimchi]], which turned out to be much spicier than Max expected. On the way home, Sofia bought a bag of [[toffee]] for their parents. Unfortunately, by the time they got off the bus, the bag was mysteriously empty.

b2-07.title: An anniversary surprise
b2-07.story: Anna's parents were celebrating their twentieth anniversary, so Anna helped Dad plan a surprise for Mama. First, he booked a table at a quiet [[wine bar]] by the river, where Mama ordered a glass of [[chardonnay]]. They shared a plate of soft [[brie]] with grapes and crackers. Later, they moved on to a seafood restaurant, where Dad had grilled [[crab]] and Mama tried [[lobster]] for the first time. Meanwhile, Anna, Taras, and their grandparents were secretly decorating the living room. When the couple returned, all their friends jumped out and shouted, "Surprise!" Mama laughed until she cried, because she had no idea a [[cocktail party]] was waiting for her at home.

b2-08.title: Breakfast at home
b2-08.story: Every Saturday morning, Anna's kitchen turns into a busy little café. Mama always has [[avocado toast]] with a boiled egg, while Dad sticks to [[muesli]] and coffee. Anna prefers crunchy [[granola]] with yogurt and a spoonful of [[chia]] seeds on top. The night before, she also prepared a jar of [[chia pudding]] made with [[soya]] milk for Grandma. Taras, who refuses anything green, gets a colorful [[smoothie bowl]] with bananas and berries. This morning, Mama decided to try something new: a warm bowl of [[quinoa]] with apple [[puree]] and cinnamon. She proudly announced that it was a real [[superfood]]. Taras took one look at it and quietly asked for pancakes instead.
